market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $130 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$102 May 2; needs CME settlement >=$130 by end-June, ~28% above spot. Beyond high end of analyst forecast range ($105-125). Would require severe escalation of Hormuz blockade or broader regional war. EIA Q2 peak ~$115 base case. Tail event but Iran conflict keeps it non-negligible.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether war broadens or Saudi/UAE supply gets disrupted.
